facts.fact: Egypt's State Information Service says ITIDA serves as the country's root certification authority for electronic signatures.
Egypt's State Information Service says ITIDA regulates, licenses and monitors providers of electronic signature and seal services, and Egypt keeps a trusted list of digital trust service providers.
facts.system: Egypt national trusted list of digital trust service providers

EGY.note: The document names no law on electronic transactions or signatures, only ITIDA's regulatory role and an EU arrangement.
The document says nothing about health data systems.
It names no ISO, IEC or ITU standard adopted nationally, no membership and no rule; an EU trusted-list arrangement is not a standards adoption.
The only agreement is with the European Union, not an African body.
